SolarEdge — peer benchmark

SEDG-peer-benchmark-2026-10-17 · USD · series 2026-10-17T22:00:00Z · built 2026-10-17 20:02 UTC

The short version

Installers and distributors buy SolarEdge's inverters, panel optimizers and home batteries to turn rooftop solar into usable power. Every name here sells that same inverter electronics, but each sells it in different places and to different buyers. Enphase is the main US rival and sells microinverters, mostly to US homes. Tigo sells panel-level optimizers, mostly in Europe, and is a fraction of SolarEdge's size; it listed through a May 2023 merger with a SPAC shell, and its filings reach back to 2022. SMA is the German string-inverter maker selling into homes, businesses and utility-scale plants, and it reports in euros. Sungrow is the Chinese inverter and battery-storage maker, the largest in the set, and it reports in yuan. SMA and Sungrow keep their own currency panels; share counts and percentages need no currency, so those charts set them beside the dollar reporters wherever they print the line.

Dig question: SolarEdge is losing money while Enphase and Sungrow make it. Is that because of where SolarEdge sells and what it sells, or because it earns less on the same kind of sale?

For the week ending October 11, 2026, Enphase traded at 33.2× trailing earnings and Tigo at 6.4×, a multiple that rests on Q4 2025 net income of $11.7M against operating income of $0.3M. SolarEdge's earnings multiple has been blank since 2024-W14, and its price to free cash flow was 22.7× against Enphase's 29.4×.

In the first half of 2026, SMA's revenue was €686.6M, up 0.3% on €684.9M a year earlier, and its EBIT was €62.4M against −€19.0M. Sungrow's was ¥30.9B, down 29%, the first half-year decline in the reports read here.

Key metrics

MetricTrendLine
Revenue (2025)Second of the dollar reportersSolarEdge $1.18B, against $1.47B for Enphase and $104M for Tigo. SMA reported €1.52B and Sungrow ¥89.2B.
Operating margin (2025)Lowest in the setSolarEdge −25.5%, against 10.7% for Enphase, −4.3% for Tigo and −12.4% for SMA. Sungrow's operating-profit line is a different measure.
Operating margin (Q2 2026)Closing the gapSolarEdge −4.6%, up from −39.9% a year earlier, against 17.7% for Enphase and −6.6% for Tigo.
Trailing multiple (2026-W41)Blank, loss-makingSolarEdge is blank, against 33.2× for Enphase and 6.4× for Tigo. SMA and Sungrow have no weekly series.
US or Americas share (2025)Between Enphase and SMA61% of SolarEdge's revenue came from the US, against 81% for Enphase. Americas were 42% for SMA and 26% for Tigo.
Storage share (2025)Behind SungrowHome batteries were 24% of SolarEdge's revenue, against 42% for Sungrow's storage systems and 9% for Tigo's GO ESS.
Diluted shares (2025)RisingSolarEdge 59.0M, up from 57.1M in 2024, while Enphase fell to 134.9M from 140.0M.

Open gaps

  • Tigo before 2022: Tigo was private until its May 2023 merger with the Roth CH IV SPAC shell, and its filings print nothing before 2022 or January–March 2022 alone. Its October–December 2022 revenue and operating income are the full year less nine months, and it printed no per-share figures for that quarter.
  • SolarEdge before its March 2015 listing: its first annual report prints full years from July 2012 and quarters from July 2013, and only July–December 2013 has no per-share figures. For July–December 2014 the 10-Qs print diluted EPS as a dash beside the share count, so those two EPS cells are blank.
  • SMA and Sungrow quarters are not shown, only their annual and half-year figures.
  • Sungrow does not report a diluted weighted-average share count.
  • Sungrow's operating profit under Chinese accounting rules includes investment income, fair-value gains and impairments, so it is not the same measure as the others' operating income and stays in its own panel.
  • SMA and Sungrow have no weekly earnings or free-cash-flow multiple.
  • Regions: Enphase reports the US and international only. Tigo and SMA report EMEA, the Americas and Asia-Pacific. Sungrow reports mainland China and overseas. SolarEdge's regional split starts in 2021. Tigo reports its US share for 2025 only.
  • Storage: Enphase and SMA do not break out battery revenue. SolarEdge breaks out home batteries from 2021, and Tigo gives an approximate GO ESS figure for 2023–2025.
  • Tigo's price to free cash flow is blank every week because its trailing free cash flow is negative.
  • Forward multiples are blank for every company.
  • Weekly multiples are blank wherever trailing earnings were a loss. Year-over-year growth is blank because of losses wherever either period was a loss.

Definitions

  • Tigo's net income is the loss attributable to common stockholders, after cumulative preferred dividends.
  • Before 2017 the quarterly axis follows SolarEdge's June year, with each peer on its own fiscal quarter of the same number.
